profile.headline: Frontend React Developer
profile.summary: I graduated from Texas State University with a bachelors in Computer Science. I have proficiency in production support in Java, SpringBoot, and ReactJS applications. Ask me about my SIM Racing Rig!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Designed and developed highly responsive web pages, improving customer engagement and increasing user satisfaction ratings.
• Translated UI/UX designs into high-quality code, enabling the launch of a key product feature used by over 1 million users.
• Collaborated closely with back-end developers, project managers, and business leaders to define project requirements and deliverables.
• Played a key role in launching a high-profile project by collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving significant business growth and delivering value for the client.
• Enhanced team productivity, saving ~3 hours per sprint, by introducing optimized Git aliases and custom VSCode build tasks.
• Mentored junior developers, leading to a 50% reduction in on-boarding time and a noticeable improvement in code quality across the team.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Java · Git · Splunk · Kibana · Spring Boot · Production Support · HTML5 · CSS3 · Datadog · Springboot

positions.title: Freelance Video Editor
positions.description:
Filmed live surgery's within the O.R. with the head surgeon as he narrated his process from start to finish. 
Edited that footage into 4-5 minute videos to be posted to YouTube and other social media.
Created custom animations and effects (e.g. intro, outro, lower thirds).

positions.title: Computer Network Grader
positions.description:
Reviewed and graded 62 students' projects and assignments in a timely matter.
Updated and maintained student grades via Microsoft Excel.
Maintained professional and private communication between professor and students daily.

positions.title: Logo Designer & Server
positions.description:
Created and designed the company website, logo, billboard, and T-shirts sold at the restaurant.
Handled updates and debugging of the company website.
Provided excellent customer service for customers in the dining and bar sections.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Built and repaired custom PCs for customers.
Repaired customer products, audio equipment, and small electronics to ensure customer satisfaction.
Met and exceeded quarterly sales goals.
Corrected issues for any customer issues.
